_comment: Shared fixtures for the SIGMA-203 compatibility gate, asserted by BOTH
The control plane owns the decision; the dashboard re-implements it only
so demo mode — which has no control plane and no wrong hardware to plug
in — can show the state at all. Two implementations of one rule drift,
and the drift would be invisible: the demo would quietly refuse hosts the
real gate accepts, or word the same refusal differently.
This file is the referee. Every case names a host, the type it was
enrolled as, and the EXACT verdict both sides must produce, sentence
included — the sentence is rendered verbatim to an operator, so changing
it is a product decision that should have to be made once, here.
Adding a requirement to the catalog means adding cases here (failing AND
passing) before either side is finished.

cases.name: an ordinary box connected as a GPU server

expect.expected: An NVIDIA GPU with a usable driver.
expect.reason: You connected this as a GPU server, but no NVIDIA GPU was detected.

cases.name: a card with no driver behind it

expect.expected: An NVIDIA GPU with a usable driver.
expect.reason: You connected this as a GPU server, but its NVIDIA GPU has no usable driver.

cases.name: a GPU host on the wrong CPU architecture

expect.reason: You connected this as a GPU server, but its CPU architecture is arm64 — that type needs amd64.

cases.name: a 120 GB VPS connected as object storage

expect.reason: You connected this as a Storage server, but it has 120 GB of disk — that type needs at least 500 GB.

cases.name: a distro outside the onboardable set

expect.expected: Runs Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS or Debian 12.
expect.reason: You connected this as a General server, but it runs Fedora Linux 41 (Workstation Edition) — that type needs Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS or Debian 12.

cases.name: two requirements violated at once, in catalog order

expect.expected: Runs Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS or Debian 12.
expect.reason: You connected this as a Storage server, but it runs Fedora Linux 41 — that type needs Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS or Debian 12.
You connected this as a Storage server, but it has 120 GB of disk — that type needs at least 500 GB.

cases.name: the same ordinary box, filed as what it is
an agent that predates every one of these facts
an agent that reported only its architecture
